title: Meet the Matchmaker
caption:
Nice to meet you properly. I'm Segun Babajide, the founder of Real Estate Matchmakers, and I've been in the real estate business for over 10 years.

I spent years in IT, risk and audit, where the first rule is simple: check before you trust. I run this business the same way. Every home and plot we show you has had its title, survey and price checked first.

We work across Lagos and Abuja, with buyers at home and abroad. Tell me what you're looking for and I'll find the right match.

title: Payment plans: 4 checks (carousel)
caption:
Payment plans are the reason many people can finally own land in Nigeria. A small deposit, then monthly payments you can manage.

But a payment plan is only as good as the paperwork behind it. Before you pay any deposit, check these 4 things: get it in writing, know exactly what you're securing, agree what happens if you miss a payment, and confirm the estate's title.

Save this post for when you're ready to buy.

#PaymentPlan #LandForSale #AbujaLand #LagosRealEstate #PropertyInNigeria #RealEstateMatchmakers

title: Quote: never regret buying
caption:
I've been in the real estate business for over 10 years, and I've heard too many stories of people who paid for land that was sold twice, or a house with papers that turned out to be fake.

That's why I'd rather lose a sale than show you something I haven't checked. Buying property should be the best decision you make, not the one you regret.
